headline: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) Posts Q4 CY2025 Sales In Line With Estimates
summary: Engineering and automation solutions company Emerson (NYSE:EMR) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 4.1% year on year to $4.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Emerson Reports First Quarter 2026 Results; Updates 2026 Outlook
summary: Emerson (NYSE: EMR) today reported results for its first quarter ended December 31, 2025 and updated its full year outlook for fiscal 2026.
